property_summary: For every admissible amount v (0 <= v <= contract balance), calling withdraw(v) as owner decreases the contract's balance by exactly v; the mutant always sends 1 wei, so the balance drop is 1 instead of v whenever v != 1.
change_summary: Change the transfer amount to a fixed 1 wei so withdraw(uint256) always sends exactly 1 wei regardless of _value.
